senses.zh_definition: 凯斯勒：德语来源的姓氏；具体指谁须由上下文确定。
senses.en_definition: Kessler, a surname of German origin whose bearer must be identified from context.
senses.ms_definition: Nama keluarga yang berasal daripada bahasa Jerman; orang yang dirujuk perlu dikenal pasti melalui konteks.
senses.nuances: 属于 kata nama khas，即专有名词。不能把姓氏直接翻译成其历史职业含义，也不能仅凭这个词判断人物身份或族群。参见 [姓氏来源词典](https://www.familysearch.org/en/surname?surname=kessler)。以下为专名使用组合，不代表普通词的高频搭配。

senses.zh_definition: 在 sindrom Kessler 这一专名中，指以 Donald J. Kessler 命名的轨道碎片碰撞连锁增殖现象。
senses.en_definition: In Kessler syndrome, the eponym identifying a cascading increase in orbital debris through collisions.
senses.ms_definition: Unsur nama khas dalam sindrom Kessler, iaitu keadaan apabila pelanggaran objek di orbit menghasilkan serpihan yang mencetuskan pelanggaran selanjutnya.
senses.nuances: 这是整个术语 sindrom Kessler 的含义，不是 kessler 单独具有“太空垃圾”的普通词义。该情景由 Kessler 于 1978 年提出。参见 [NASA：轨道碎片管理](https://www.nasa.gov/wp-content/uploads/2018/12/692076main_orbital_debris_management_and_risk_mitigation.pdf)。

dual_scenarios.en: The report explains that Kessler syndrome involves cascading collisions between objects and debris in orbit.

etymology.historical_story: Kessler belongs to a tradition of surnames associated with occupations. Its German history connects it with makers of kettles and copper vessels. Once used as a surname, however, it identifies a family or person, not a present-day occupation. Malay preserves that naming function when referring to a bearer or to a term named after one. [Surname dictionary](https://www.familysearch.org/en/surname?surname=kessler)
